name: BURLY Coffee
why_included: Rated good for working; big windows, wifi, ~25 seats.

name: Variety Coffee (Greenpoint/Driggs)
why_included: Strong wifi, plenty of outlets, laptop-sized tables; fills ~11am.

name: Café Miguel
why_included: Strong wifi; busy with laptop workers and coffee dates (Infatuation, Sep 2026).

name: Irving Farm (W 3rd St)
why_included: Plenty of seating and outlets per 2025 guide; another 2026 guide says no WiFi, bring a hotspot.

name: The Lost Draft
why_included: Big tables, WiFi, outlets, bookable private table-read room; group-friendly; noisy; reported 2-hour WiFi limit.

name: 787 Coffee (W 10th St)
why_included: Reliable WiFi and plenty of outlets; closes ~6pm.

name: 1 Hotel Brooklyn Bridge
why_included: Plant-filled high-ceiling lobby lounge with couches and big windows; Neighbors cafe off lobby, coffee purchase implied. Quiet on weekday mornings.

name: Kimpton Hotel Eventi
why_included: Living Room behind the lobby with fireplace, Wi-Fi, outlets; no reservation needed to work. Bar nearby; outdoor plaza in good weather.

name: ICP Cafe (International Center of Photography)
why_included: Ground-floor cafe in ICP's free public space: free Wi-Fi, laptop plug-in stations, ample seating. Free Incubator Space too. Museum hours only.

name: Ace Hotel New York
why_included: Classic laptop lobby: big communal table plus lounge seating, free Wi-Fi, Stumptown up front; noisy, dim, outlets spotty. Group-friendly. Buying a drink is customary.

name: Boro Hotel
why_included: LIC's best work lobby per Time Out: natural light, tables, sofas, free Wi-Fi; non-guests buy coffee or drinks at cafe-bar.
